extDescription.message: Hands-free YouTube Shorts: moves to the next Short when one ends or on a timer you choose. Bounded, visible sessions. No data collected.

tapSkipHint.message: Off by default. Only YouTube's own Skip button is clicked, never the ad itself. This may conflict with YouTube's terms.

notAffiliated.message: Not affiliated with or endorsed by YouTube or Google.

openYoutube.message: Open youtube.com/shorts in this tab first.

pause_touched.message: paused: you are using the page

end_away.message: Session ended: you left Shorts for 60 s.

telemetryHint.message: Off by default. Counts only: how sessions end, your settings, and whether YouTube's page changed. Never videos, URLs or history.

skipAdShortsHint.message: Off by default. Swipes to the next Short when an ad Short shows; never clicks the ad. May conflict with YouTube's terms.
